package rulefixtures

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"log/slog"
	"os"
)

// scenario for go_perf_layer_logging_overhead_log_fields_built_before_level_check: Layer: Logging overhead. Flag expensive log field construction before checking whether the level is enabled.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: performance; severity: contextual.
func scenario560Positive(req map[string]interface{}) {
	// Expensive JSON serialization of a large request payload is
	// performed eagerly — even when the log level is INFO and the
	// debug log will never be emitted.
	payload, _ := json.Marshal(req)
	slog.Debug("request received", slog.String("body", string(payload)))
}

func init() {
	slog.SetDefault(slog.New(slog.NewTextHandler(os.Stderr, &slog.HandlerOptions{Level: slog.LevelInfo})))
}
